propositions: Makefile typecheck target runs mypy over src/rebar only, excluding 47 Python files in scripts/ that are lint-checked but type-unchecked
CI gating scripts like scripts/check_verify_gate_parity.py enforce the Verified vote but lie outside the mypy typecheck scope
Widening mypy scope to include scripts/ surfaces 15 type errors across 6 script files, all resolvable via proper annotations without per-module overrides

Two latent bugs are revealed when scripts/ enters typecheck scope: capture_jira_fixtures calls .strip() on str | None, and check_complexity_baseline passes possibly-None dict where dict[str, int] is required
Stale scope descriptions in .pre-commit-config.yaml and .github/workflows/_build-and-test.yml incorrectly claim typecheck covers 'full library' or 'full src/rebar' without mentioning scripts/
Guard test must verify that typecheck recipe includes both src/rebar and scripts/ as mypy arguments, and must fail if the scope is later re-narrowed
